purpose: Determine whether SMP contains enough stable multi-component abundance panels for a prospective macroecological test of breeding-space contraction.

primary_hierarchy.rationale: The large SMP abundance extract is organized around SiteID, Site and MasterSite; repeated named plots are retained only as a stricter secondary scale.

secondary_hierarchy.status: use only if a separate plot-level extract contains stable longitudinal identifiers and boundary-history metadata

row_exclusions_before_eligibility: records lacking usable species, season, parent ID or component ID
aggregate or merged-site totals overlapping child SiteID counts
records with incompatible abundance units inside a candidate panel unless an externally documented deterministic conversion exists
known SiteID splits, merges, replacements or boundary changes without a versioned crosswalk
duplicate component x season records that cannot be resolved from provenance
missing survey rows interpreted as zero; only explicit zero or nil returns may be zero

panel_gate.window_selection: Choose the longest qualifying stable-identity window using coverage metadata only. No abundance magnitude may enter window selection.

macro_gate.decision: Only if all minima pass may SMP abundance magnitudes be opened for the prospective macro test.

future_primary_predictions_if_gate_passe: Null-calibrated concentration during decline is positive on average across eligible units.
A smooth relationship predicts held-out systems at least as well as frozen collapse hinges at 50%, 25% or 10% abundance remaining.
The magnitude of null-calibrated concentration varies among species and systems and will be tested against a predeclared finite trait set.
required_request_fields: explicit zero or nil-return field if distinct from Count=0
notes: Raw kappa is not the cross-system response because finite component number, sampling schedule and zero-boundary mechanics vary among panels.
The future response must be calibrated against a panel-specific proportional-thinning observation model.
No result from the five penguin discovery trajectories may be used to tune SMP eligibility after this contract.
If the macro gate fails, the frozen Ecology Report proceeds and the SMP extension closes without outcome fishing.
